fieldData.name: Apartments with Dog Parks: What They Include, What They Cost, and How to Find Them
fieldData.seo-title: Apartments with Dog Parks: Costs, Safety Rules & Best Cities (2026) | brightplace
fieldData.meta-description: Apartments with dog parks vary widely in size, cost, and quality. Learn what the amenity includes, dog park etiquette rules, and which cities have the most options.
fieldData.post-summary: Apartments with dog parks offer on-site, fenced off-leash areas where your dog can exercise without leaving the property. According to PetScreening's 2026 report, pet parks are mentioned in 58% of rental property descriptions. This guide covers what the amenity includes across four tiers, what it costs, dog park safety and etiquette rules, how on-site parks compare to public parks, and which cities have the most options.
